data.raw: A black and white photograph of a vintage telephone handset and its base. The handset is positioned on the left, with its coiled cord extending towards the right. The base of the telephone is visible on the right side, featuring a circular dial and several buttons. The image is high-contrast, with the telephone appearing in dark tones against a light background.

This image is a high-contrast, black-and-white scan of a page from a 1942 German telephone directory (Reichstelefonbuch). The page is heavily distorted by extreme contrast, making most text illegible. The layout shows vertical columns of text, likely representing town names or regions, with horizontal lines indicating telephone entries. Some faint, larger characters or symbols are visible in the center, possibly '10' or '11'. The overall appearance is that of a heavily degraded or photocopied document.

A high-contrast, black and white photograph showing a person's face partially obscured by a chain-link fence. The image is grainy and has a stark, dramatic quality. The person's face is visible through the mesh, with one eye and part of the cheek clearly shown. The lighting is harsh, creating deep shadows and bright highlights on the metal links of the fence and the person's skin. The overall mood is somber and mysterious.

A grainy, black-and-white photograph showing a pig lying on its side, suspended by metal chains. The pig's head is on the left, and its body extends towards the right. The chains are visible on the right side, suggesting the animal is being held in a specific position, possibly for a medical or scientific experiment. The background is dark and indistinct.
